load_pdf_from_path: load a PDF file and return page images with names and optional page range and DPI
load_image_from_path: load a single image file and return it as an RGB image with its name
load_from_file_auto_detect: load a file by auto-detecting whether it is a PDF or image and return images with names
load_from_folder_batch: load all images and PDFs from a folder and return combined images with names
load_lang_file_by_names: load a language mapping JSON file and return language codes for given names
